detaileddescription.para: This will return a different value after every renumbering. dropAllReferences() - This method causes all the subinstructions to "let go" of all references that they are maintaining.

detaileddescription.para: This allows one to 'delete' a whole module at a time, even though there may be circular references... first all references are dropped, and all use counts go to zero. Then everything is deleted for real. Note that no operations are valid on an object that has "dropped all references", except operator delete.
Since no other object in the module can have references into the body of a function, dropping all references deletes the entire body of the function, including any contained basic blocks.
